correctness.rationale: Rebuilt the 27 tetrahedra from Bagchi–Datta 5-path deletion and Spreer three nine-cycle difference orbits; both definitions coincide. Full f=(9,36,54,27), graph-cycle presentation 28 columns and 54 triangle relations has Smith diagonal 1 repeated 27 times, H1=Z. The integer winding W=sum(nearest residues)/9 is a genuine 1-cocycle: vanishes on all 54 faces, is +1 on all 30 missing triangles with cyclic orientation, so they are primitive integral generators; four orbit counts 9,9,9,3 and minimal simple length 3 follow. Independently computed the complete finite Smith form and all 84 triples; the result holds only for this fixed complex, not all triangulations.

evidence: Spreer identifies K^3_9 as minimal and tight; Bagchi defines tightness via inclusion-injective homology over a field.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Field-level nontriviality of an induced empty-triangle cycle follows under appropriate tightness, but this does not determine integral primitivity or exact cyclic gap orbits. Integral winding is independently needed.
